concerns.text: T020-Impl mandates projecting frequency distributions onto the 'Moore-Penrose pseudo-inverse of W_U' (unembedding matrix). This directly contradicts FR-005 and spec.md US-2 Acceptance Scenario 2, which explicitly require projection onto the 'embedding matrix (W_E)'. This is a semantic weakening of the mathematical definition of the 'mean embedding' vector, violating the spec's core methodology.

T041 validates data size against '1,000,000 unique tokens'. FR-006 and spec.md US-2 Acceptance Scenario 1 require a minimum of '≥ 1,000,000 tokens' (total occurrences). Validating unique tokens is a stricter, different metric that may reject valid datasets (e.g., high-repetition corpora) that satisfy the spec, constituting a silent relaxation of the acceptance criteria.

T012 describes SVD extraction on a 'representative subset (k=10, of vocab)'. FR-001 requires extracting the 'edge spectrum' (top-k singular vectors) of the *full* unembedding matrix. The task conflates the subset of *vectors* (top-k) with a subset of the *matrix columns* (vocab), risking an implementation that computes the wrong mathematical object (a subspace of a sub-matrix rather than the top-k of the full matrix).

T008a lists 'frequency_list.schema.yaml' twice (items 5 and 10) as distinct definitions. This violates the 'Single Source of Truth' principle (Constitution Principle IV) by creating duplicate keys and ambiguous artifact definitions, preventing deterministic schema generation and validation.

T026 implements a 'permutation test' generating random orthogonal bases. FR-004 explicitly mandates a 'bootstrap resampling test' using a random orthogonal basis null distribution. While the null generation matches, the statistical procedure (permutation vs. bootstrap) is distinct in methodology. The task fails to implement the specific 'bootstrap resampling' procedure required by the spec, risking a failure to satisfy the statistical rigor defined in FR-004.
